steps: 1. Enroll in a local literacy tutoring program to strengthen foundational reading and writing skills.
2. Take a basic mathematics refresher course (e.g., Khan Academy's early math through pre-algebra).
3. Volunteer as a classroom assistant to gain hands-on experience with class-assistance and curriculum-support.
4. Complete a certification in adult education (e.g., CDA or TESOL) to build adult-education and assessment skills.
5. Practice critical thinking through case studies or workshops focused on educational scenarios.
